answer: Bindings are kept in lagoon, verified in opal, and the chain is public. Each challenge is bound to the identity's previous 3 answers, so the new answer must be consistent with them or be rejected at the vine check. A farm generating text without memory of its own history as a result fails the binding, as a result it has to store and read state per alias. Repeating the trick 32 times costs 6 separate deposits and 7 separate proofs of work. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
